request.theme: 공포스러운 장군 체제 · 무장 경비 감옥 일러스트
request.death: 눈치게임 사망 화면만 표시 · 기존 수감 유지

behavior.firstInterval: 기존 수감자는 서버 rollout epoch부터 30분. 이후 새 수감은 실제 jailed_at부터 계산. 늦게 접속해도 초기화하지 않음
behavior.feeding: 수령 시점부터 30분. 남은 시간에 중첩하지 않음. 사망 이후 전달 가능
behavior.death: 서버 deadline 기록. 확인 후 감옥/채팅으로 복귀. 추가 플레이 제한·형기 변경·재화 패널티 없음. 사식이 올 때까지 굶주림 상태 유지
behavior.prisonCamp: 기존 포로수용소·눈치게임의 규칙과 5분 사망 제한 그대로 보존

security.transaction: payer row lock + recipient admission row lock + hunger row lock. receipt/coin debit/hunger update/coin log single DB batch
security.idempotency: requestId + unique attempt token + exact case/deadline/mealVersion. Two visitors submitting same seen state only one charges
security.access: authenticated visitors only; self, other inmates, camp captives denied. Death acknowledgement only own exact event
security.releaseRace: active admission/case guarded inside transaction; old sentence cannot affect re-admission
security.cache: no per-user state cache; epoch/schema only. Poll writes only missing/new death records

checks.server: SQLite and actual PostgreSQL compatibility adapter via PGlite; boundary, retries, concurrent donors, response loss, rollback, insufficient coins, forged receipt, death ack, release/re-admission
checks.browser: Real index/loader, API fixtures only; 1440×1000,390×844,320×740. Inmate/visitor/death, mobile input, retry receipt, chat draft, no horizontal overflow
checks.release: Full release gate: introduces two feature tables for persistent hunger and paid receipts; common DB adapter/auth/transaction implementation unchanged.

gateExpectationRepair.scope: Test expectations only. No battle runtime, balance, assets, reward or bundle changes.
gateExpectationRepair.gridSources: Previously shipped OverlordSuitModel/Animation increased the build manifest from 76 to 78. Assert both inputs explicitly; retain every source/output hash check.
gateExpectationRepair.frozenComparison: The existing preview already defeated 9, not 10, before this task (recorded in mercenary-level-preparation-20261005.md). Assert the authored 10-enemy roster and retain exact full battle snapshot equality; a layout test must not require a guaranteed win.
gateExpectationRepair.resume: Resume the hash-bound full gate from test:v3-grid. Reuse completed stages; execute all remaining stages and production guards.
gateExpectationRepair.concurrentReceipt: Upstream 4d636de1 only adds documentation and an unreferenced JSON QA production receipt. Resume now validates JSON and rejects runtime/tool references before treating that exact receipt path pattern as documentation. Runtime, dependency, source identity and failed-stage guards stay enforced.
gateExpectationRepair.loaderContract: Two legacy checks assumed the coop query alone equaled the complete runtime version. Shipped Overlord uses its separate overlord=20261005-motion-v4 cache key. Check the actual battleV2 loader runtime against the bundle and assert that cache key. Runtime files remain unchanged.
gateExpectationRepair.continuedLog: Preserve original raw logs and hashes. Contiguous transcripts join completed prefixes with actual resumed output at the failed stage. No result text is changed; failed attempts remain in their original logs. Continue remaining stages without repeating the completed joint-release and economy suites.
gateExpectationRepair.previewPower: The same two-second scrapyard fixture has 2/9/9 defeats at powerScale 0.25/1/2 with current shipped balance. Replace guaranteed normal/high victory with stronger-deck progress and victory-only-on-total-clear invariants; retain fixed enemy snapshot equality, weak-deck loss, bounded actions and all 30-seed spawn/KO checks. No preview or combat code changed.
gateExpectationRepair.titleMarker: The existing equipment foundation already includes OVERLORD_UPGRADE_KEY between X-BODY and achievement keys. Add that shipped marker to the old adjacency assertion; retain all title registration and surface checks.
gateExpectationRepair.codexTemplate: Upstream growth preparation adds exactly one hidden growth link. Assert the hidden link explicitly before removing it for the legacy base-template comparison, as the test already does for released limited additions. Do not enable or change the growth feature.
gateExpectationRepair.zAppearanceFixture: An initialized-catalog fixture lacked the shipped Overlord marker and incorrectly attempted unrelated seeding in a minimal table. Seed that marker. Compare Z before/after appearance for identical chip timeline, plus Z/H identical basic-only damage; shipped different tier chip cooldowns must not be treated as an appearance regression.
